task_summary: Executed 100% database purge and complete workflow re-seed using seed_full_workflow.js. Hardened seeder with verified Password123! bcrypt hash, dual local/Docker MongoDB host URI resolution, CMS-V2 institutional role mappings (Admin -> instructor, Co-Admin -> instructor, Faculty Committee -> faculty), academic foundation records (AcademicYear, Course BSIT, Sections 4-A/4-B), singleton SystemSettings, compound index-compliant evaluations (projectId, panelistId, defenseType), and verified live authentication across all 17 persona credentials.
lessons_learned: Lesson: Ad-hoc hardcoded bcrypt hashes in test seeders must be verified programmatically with bcrypt.compareSync before deployment; dummy hashes cause silent 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS lockouts across all seeded user accounts.

Lesson learned: Mongo collections with compound unique indexes (e.g. evaluations { projectId: 1, panelistId: 1, defenseType: 1 }) will immediately throw MongoServerError E11000 duplicate key error if seeder documents omit indexed discriminator fields and default to null.

Prevention: Always include academic prerequisites (AcademicYear, Course, Section) and singleton system settings (key: 'global') when executing complete database purges so client forms and dropdowns do not render empty selector states.
